title: What Is Drama in English Literature? — Drama and Its Types
skills: define drama as a literary form
distinguish dramatic genres by their characteristics
analyze how dramatic form shapes plot, conflict, and audience experience
alignment_note: Introduces drama as a literary form and surveys major dramatic types and their distinguishing characteristics. Supports genre recognition, literary classification, analysis of dramatic structure, and comparison of how different forms of drama develop conflict, character, and meaning across high school English courses.
